description: Source code implementing ASN.1 message structures and encoding/decoding functions for UL-CCCH1 messages in 3GPP RRC NR protocol, including classes for message types, serialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: ul_ccch1_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the UL-CCCH1 message sequence, including packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ul_ccch1_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice of message type within UL-CCCH1, including methods to set and serialize different message options.

classes.name: ul_ccch1_msg_type_c::c1_c_
classes.description: Nested class representing specific message options within the choice, such as rrc_resume_request1.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request1_s
classes.description: Represents the RRC Resume Request message, including packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request1_ies_s
classes.description: Represents the IEs (Information Elements) of the RRC Resume Request, with methods for serialization and JSON conversion.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message or IE into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message or IE from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the message or IE to JSON format.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to c1.

methods.name: set_rrc_resume_request1
methods.description: Sets the message type to rrc_resume_request1.
